dialog.wiki.title.gameplay.storage.descr:
Collecting goods is great and all, but, you also need place to store them right ? 
Depending on your resources, you can create different storage blocks with varying amounts of space within them.

dialog.wiki.page.crafting.fletching_tabl:
Want to shoot someting ? The fletching Table is the place for you !. 
here you can craft all kinds of arrows .
 The recipe is simple - just place flint,stick and feather (top to bottom).
when you get bored from the regular arrows you can put special ingridiants in the extra slot to add effect to the arrows.
dialog.wiki.page.crafting.crucible:
The hottest block in this part of the world 
here we cam melt raw ores into ingots with much more efficiency and mix metals togather to create alloys
dialog.wiki.page.crafting.alchemy_table:
I don't really expect many of you to appreciate the subtle science and exact art that is potion-making
Here you can bottle fame, brew glory, and even put a stopper in death.
you can mix varius ingredients into potions or modifying items
for now only potion recipes exist
dialog.wiki.page.crafting.cooking_pot:
The cooking pot  use to brew warm and tasty meals 
in order to use the pot you need lit a camfire under it 
 to brew stew or soup put bowl in the bottom slot and ingridiants in the 6 slots above
dialog.wiki.page.crafting.anvil:
The anvil opens the next level of gear.
put the material you want to craft with(steel) in the grid then craft hammer and hit the anvil few times
when the item is ready it drop on top of the anvil
dialog.wiki.page.crafting.campfire:
The campfire is block that let you cook and dry items. 
in order to lit the campfire you need to right click on it with Fire plough.
When lit, the campfire will stay lit for 10 secends - indicated by the timer above.
to extend the timer use fuel items like plank, coal, stick etc,better items provide more burning time.
when the timer reach 0 secends the campfire will turn off
dialog.wiki.page.worldgen.biomes.sniffer:
The Sniffer Garden is a special biome that has been preserved since ancient times. 
It is the only place in the world where the sniffers have  yet to become extinct.
In addition, it has a pleasant temperature throughout the year and apparently no monsters appear there.
dialog.wiki.page.worldgen.structures.pil: The pillagers camp is structure that can spawn on the surface in most overworld biomes
The pillagers use those camps as temporary bases for their scouts when they on misson to find helpless villages and concure them
dialog.wiki.page.tools.sword.summary: It have sharp edge, perfect for slicing monsters
dialog.wiki.page.tools.shovel.summary: The unique shape of the shovel make it perfect for digging soft materials
dialog.wiki.page.tools.sculpture_tool.su: this revolutionary tool let us sculpt wooden logs to crafting tables now we can craft even more advanced technology
dialog.wiki.page.tools.pickaxe.summary:
Tha classic good old pickaxe 
is there any need to explain ? it can break through hard rocks and makes your life easier
dialog.wiki.page.tools.knife.summary:
Ouch its sharp ! 
knife can be used to cut plants into plant fiber
its also cheaper than swords so its perfect as early weapon
dialog.wiki.page.tools.hoe.summary:
love plants ? this is the toll for you ! 
The hoe can turn the soil into the perfect place for various seeds to grow.
dialog.wiki.page.tools.hammer.summary: Hit anvil with the hammer to process ingots into tools
dialog.wiki.page.tools.fishing_rod.summa:
With this amazing tool we can catch all those slippery fish
just be carful to not disturb anything dangerus
dialog.wiki.page.tools.fire_plough.summa:
our experiments shows that if you rub two stick fast enough they become so hot that fire will start.
can be used to lit blocks and campfires
dialog.wiki.page.tools.axe.summary:
Chop chop chop ! 
the best friend of the lumberjack 
it can chop trees and peel logs
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.storage.storag:
Collecting goods is great and all, but, you also need place to store them right ? 
Depending on your resources, you can create different storage blocks with varying amounts of space within them.
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.seasons.summar:
There are 4 seasons in Better than Sniffers 

you start the game in the autumn 

every season have diffrent effects on the ambient temperature and growth rate for crops

the season cycle is 
autumn -> winter -> spring -> summer

the easiest season is spring while the hardes is winter
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.movement.jump_: Jump height decreased to exactly 1 block .
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.movement.wall_:
Wall Run :
if you run paralel to wall while there are no block beneath and you press forword+sprint you can run alongside the wall for short period

Wall edge climb : (unstable)
Press Seank+jump while loking paralel to the ground and have edge of wall in front of you
Roll : (experimental)
Press Left+righ and exctly before you touch the ground while falling from high place to negate all fall damage
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.monsters.summa:
The world is a dangerous place. Monsters lurk in the shadows, waiting for the unwary player to fall into their trap.
But while the players feel safe in the upper world, during the day, protected by the warm rays of the sun, the monsters don't sit idle, they evolved.
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.monsters.miner:
Miner Zombie:
The miner zombie is a rare variant of the regular zombie , it can mine block and break through walls in order to find somthing to eat
it can apear as zombie or husk and it will hold pickaxe in the hand
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.monsters.spide:
Spider:
 The spiders learned how to throw cobwebs ! once they cought you, its game over....
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.monsters.creep:
Creeper:
The creepers have developed a serious allergy to fire, just the slightest touch and they explode uncontrollably.
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.health_food.su:
In Better than Sniffers the natural regeneration is disabled
in order to heal yourself you must use healing items like bandages or potions
Since now food have no connection to health food items are used only to not starving
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.clay.summary:
Clay is very usefull resource.
However, in order to make its shape stable we need to harden it first.
you can place the clay on the ground under the sun and let it dry for some time 
you can also boost the drying speed if you place it in hot and dry biomes or if you put it on campfire and lit it
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.animals.summar:
The animals in Better than Sniffers are peaceful creatures All they want is to live peacefully in their natural habitat.Of course, once you attack them it's a different story and they will attack you back mercilessly.

But not evrything is lost as long as you have some food to tame them
To tame animal feed it with its favorite food
Once animal is tamed it will no longer attack you even if you kill it
Offspring of tamed animals will also not attack the player.
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.agriculture.su:
Nice day for planting, ain't it?

in this world you can find new plants that can help you survive
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.agriculture.co:
Cotton:
The seed can be obtaind from breaking grass or from sniffer digging
you can use the plant to make strings after all you grass supplies run out
dialog.wiki.page.gameplay.agriculture.ri:
Rice:
 can be obtaind from breaking grass or from sniffer digging.
 must be cooked in cooking pot before eating
dialog.sleep.title:
The game is not paused !

 while you sleep you restore small amounts of sanity over time
